checks.name: Booking confirmation durably creates its outbox event
Confirmed publish reaches notifications, preserves the trace and completes as Sent
Local SMTP inbox contains the booking confirmation addressed to the requested recipient
Concurrent idempotent booking retries create one outbox event
Broker redelivery and repeat processing do not duplicate durable notifications
Malformed events are routed to the durable dead-letter queue
Transient consumer failure uses a confirmed delayed retry
Exhausted consumer retries reach the dead-letter queue
Outbox insert failure rolls back confirmation; retry reuses the reservation without another seat deduction
Existing booking requests without email remain compatible and require a recipient
